name: update_val
title: update_val
description: Update a val's metadata including name, privacy, description, tags, image, and HTTP preview settings. All fields are optional - only provide the fields you want to update. Note that 'tags' replaces the val's whole tag list rather than adding to it. Provide the val in 'handle/valName' format (use the 'identifier' field from list_vals or get_val_detail responses). To pin an HTTP preview on the val's homepage, set pinnedFileId to the file ID of an HTTP file (from list_files). To remove the preview, set pinnedFileId to null. Changing privacy to 'private' or 'unlisted' requires the val's org (not the caller) to be on pro or business tier; if the val belongs to a free-tier org, privacy can only be set to 'public'. Use list_orgs to look up an org's tier. Note that `privacy` here is code visibility only — it does not control who can call the val's HTTP endpoints. That is the separate `httpPrivacy` (app access) axis, changed with set_http_privacy; making a val's code private does not make its endpoints unreachable.

name.description: New name for the val (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores allowed)

privacy.description: Privacy level: 'public' (discoverable), 'private' (only you), or 'unlisted' (accessible via link). The val's org tier (not the caller's) determines what's allowed: vals in free-tier orgs can only be 'public', while pro/business orgs can use any value.

description.description: Description for the val (max 64 characters, supports markdown)

imageUrl.description: URL to an image for the val's preview. Must be an https://imagedelivery.net/ URL from our image upload pipeline. Pass null to remove the current image.

tags.description: Replaces the val's ENTIRE tag list — this is not additive, so include the tags you want to keep (get_val_detail returns the current ones) and pass [] to clear them all. Max 10 tags, each 1-32 characters of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. "slack", "web-scraper"). Reuse the tags the org already uses — call list_tags first — instead of coining near-duplicates.

pinnedFileId.description: File ID of an HTTP file to pin as the homepage preview. Set to a file ID to enable preview, set to null to disable it. File IDs are available from the list_files tool.
